title: FigureBundle
description: Schema for the plotting_factory figure bundle input. Canonical at singlecell_factory/contracts/figure_bundle_schema.json.

obs_parquet.description: Path to the obs metadata parquet file (cell x obs-columns table).

obsm_parquet.description: Path to the obsm embeddings parquet file (cell x embedding-dimensions).

markers_parquet.description: Path to per-cluster marker genes parquet file. Null when marker analysis did not run.

color_config.description: Path to a YAML color/palette config file from theme/. Null to use renderer defaults.

shape_config.description: Path to a YAML shape config file. Null to use renderer defaults.

source_bundle_path.description: Provenance pointer to the upstream R bundle directory.

provenance.description: Git SHAs of all three factory repos recorded at figure-render time.

singlecell_factory_sha.description: Full git SHA of the singlecell_factory HEAD commit at render time.

r_multiomics_factory_sha.description: Full git SHA of the r_multiomics_factory HEAD commit at render time.

plotting_factory_sha.description: Full git SHA of the plotting_factory HEAD commit at render time.

rendered_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of figure render (e.g. '2026-05-18T12:00:00+00:00').
